stem: A less-than ogive and a more-than ogive are drawn for the same distribution. The two curves cross at one point. What does the x-coordinate of that point show?

per_option_rationale.rationale: The less-than ogive and more-than ogive intersect at the point where cumulative frequency = n/2 for both curves. The x-coordinate of this intersection is the median by definition.
The mode is found from a frequency histogram as the midpoint of the tallest bar, not from ogive intersection. Student confuses the graphical representation of mode with that of median.
The arithmetic mean has no direct graphical counterpart on an ogive. There is no standard ogive construction that yields the mean at an intersection point. Student confuses median with mean.

The first quartile Q1 corresponds to the x-value where the less-than ogive reaches n/4, not n/2. It does not coincide with the ogive intersection point. Student confuses the n/2 intersection with the n/4 quartile location.

explanation:
1. The less-than ogive shows cumulative frequency up to each value. The more-than ogive shows cumulative frequency from each value downward.
2. At any point x, the two ogives sum to n (total frequency).
3. KEY STEP: They intersect where each ogive equals n/2. The x-value where cumulative frequency = n/2 is the median.
4. So the x-coordinate of the intersection is the median.

explanation_sections.punchline: The less-than and more-than ogives intersect at exactly the point where each cumulative frequency equals n/2. That x-coordinate is the median by definition.
explanation_sections.approach: State the property: the two ogives sum to n at every x-value, because any observation is counted in one or the other. They are equal only where each = n/2. The x-value corresponding to the n/2 cumulative frequency is the median. Then contrast confusables: mode comes from the modal bar of a histogram, not an ogive crossing; mean has no direct ogive construction at all; Q1 is where the less-than ogive hits n/4, not n/2.
explanation_sections.lesson: Ogive intersection = median, always and only. Mode needs a histogram peak. Mean has no ogive equivalent. Q1 and Q3 come from the n/4 and 3n/4 marks on a single ogive, not from an intersection.
explanation_sections.timing: Under 30 seconds. This is a single property recall. Read the stem, recall 'intersection = median', mark option 1. Do not compute anything.
